description: This Java class 'ConfigDefinition' handles configuration file processing, including reading, parsing, and generating code templates for engine configuration structures. It manages external file references, processes structure definitions, and generates output files based on input templates.

classes.name: ConfigDefinition
classes.description: Main class for processing configuration files, generating code, and managing configuration structures.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for processing configuration files, generating headers, and templates.

methods.name: processTextTemplate
methods.description: Reads a template file, applies variable substitutions, and writes the output.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Reads and processes each line of the configuration input file, handling structures, definitions, and fields.

methods.name: handleBitLine
methods.description: Processes bit field lines within structures.

methods.name: startsWithToken
methods.description: Checks if a line starts with a specific token.

methods.name: handleStartStructure
methods.description: Handles the start of a structure definition.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles the end of a structure definition.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Generates comment string with offset information.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves size value from a string or variable registry.
